name: Dire Pangolati
descr: A carriage-sized pangolin-coati hybrid covered in armor plating. It has a bladed tail it uses to fling razor-sharp scales.

data.motivesAndTactics: Escape with a meal, slice and dice, wade into danger

features.name: Armor Eater
features.text: When the Pangolati makes a successful attack against a PC, that PC must mark an additional Armor Slot to reduce the severity of the damage.

features.name: Blade Spin
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Pangolati quickly spin in a circle. Each target within Very Close range must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take **2d8** physical damage.

features.name: Blade Fling
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to have the Pangolati flick its tail and fling a razor-edged armor plate. Make an attack against a target within Far range. On a success, the attack deals **2d6+10** physical damage.

features.name: Keratin Scales
features.text: When the Pangolati would mark HP from an attack, you can **mark a Stress** to reduce the number of HP it marks by 1.
